mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which often precedes a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines for 2 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% YoY signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight labor market with high interest rates, which typically leads to a slowdown in economic growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) for three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand, which typically leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive quarters and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) for three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases for 3 consecutive months and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
